C1391.title: Paras Jha Used Mirai Botnet to Attack Rutgers University
C1391.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice said former Rutgers University student Paras Jha launched DDoS attacks against the university network, disrupting services including its central authentication portal and increasing response and mitigation costs. Jha later pleaded guilty to related computer-crime charges; the matter, together with his Mirai botnet activity, is a representative judicial case of IoT botnet abuse.
